name: Developer Delivery Ship
tagline: Autonomous coding, refactoring, test repair, and CI verification.

charter.purpose: Execute precise software changes, maintain architecture patterns, and repair test regressions.
charter.crewAuthority: Create and run branch-scoped tests, edit local files. Direct git push requires Captain’s Approval.

name: Growth & Brand Ship
tagline: Market analysis, documentation, release notes, and community signals.

charter.purpose: Develop market intelligence and high-converting launch copy with strict human verification.
charter.crewAuthority: Draft copy, extract audience signals. External publication requires Captain’s Approval.

name: Research & Decision Ship
tagline: Synthesizing technical architectural decisions, vendor benchmarks, and risk evaluations.

charter.purpose: Provide rigorous evidence-backed decision briefs and comparative trade-off analyses.
charter.crewAuthority: Read-only search, documentation parsing, synthetic benchmarking.
